pr_title: Guard against NRE when deserializing extension data into dictionary without parameterless ctor
pr_body:
fixes #32408

**Notes**

This change means that attempting to use an `ImmutableDictionary<>` with `[JsonExtensionData]` with throw a `NotSupportedException` where previously a `NullReferenceException` was thrown from the following line:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/53c67cb43269269fd656e25b7199a065d04aeca1/src/libraries/System.Text.Json/src/System/Text/Json/Serialization/JsonSerializer.Read.HandlePropertyName.cs#L121

issue_context.title: NRE when using Immutable dictionary for [JsonExtensionData]
comments: I believe `area-System.Text.Json` is more appropriate for this issue

Similar issue to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/31645 (which is a feature request).

However, in this case, there is a bug where we are getting NRE, rather than NotSupportedException.

cc @layomia
Moving the ImmutableDictionary-as-JsonExtensionData request to https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/31645, and updating this issue to address the null ref.
